title: Thrasybulus
summary: Raleigh names Thrasybulus in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Thrasybulus, who with the banished Citizens tooke Phyla and Piraeus, and who deposed the thirtie Tyrants. The printed spelling is kept. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book III, Part I, Chapter IX, §. III, sig. 435b–436a
